programme.title: Crocodiles of the Okavango
programme.desc: Botswanan Okavangon suistoalueella nuori niilinkrokotiili aloittaa ensimmäisen kautensa emona. Saatuaan mahdollisuuden lisääntyä se joutuu kamppailemaan kiivaasti pesimäalueesta ja suojelemaan muniaan kuukausien ajan tulvilta, paahtavalta helteeltä ja armottomilta pedoilta. Varaanit, mangustit, paviaanit ja kilpailevat krokotiilit uhkaavat pesää sen vartioidessa sitä. Kun poikaset vihdoin kuoriutuvat, emo kantaa ne turvaan leukojensa välissä, mutta matka on vasta alussa. Tässä vetisessä maailmassa, jossa jopa krokotiilit saalistavat lajitovereitaan, vain harvat poikasista selviävät hengissä. Tälle ensikertalaisemolle jokainen valinta on ratkaiseva ympäristössä, jossa selviytyminen on kaikkea muuta kuin varmaa.

programme.title: Risteilyaluksen päiväkirjat
programme.desc: Costa Serenalla on uusi aikataulu ja reitti, mikä aiheuttaa ylitöitä, kun miehistö koettaa nopeasti tottua uusiin rutiineihin. On kapteeni Russon viimeinen viikko laivalla. Hän haluaa nauttia kaikesta, mitä laivalla ja satamilla on tarjota. Välimeren vaikeimmat paikat pakottavat uudet esiintyjät ottamaan kovan aallokon huomioon, kun he harjoittelevat käynnissä olevilla moottorisahoilla esitystään.

programme.title: Eurooppa ylhäältä päin
programme.desc: Tämä ilmakuvasarja paljastaa Puolan Rivieran merkittävimmät nähtävyydet ennennäkemättömällä tavalla. Jättiläiskonttisatamasta ja Gdanskin elämää sykkiviltä joulumarkkinoilta valoshow'hun Torunin kaupungissa. Teemme myös matkan upean Helin hiekkaniemimaan läpi ja tutustumme hylätyn megatehtaan salaisuuksiin.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.desc: Surf Foil World Tour

programme.title: Barcolana 50
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Together we’ll travel across the globe and follow the hottest action from the field of Kite! In this Episode, we have the opportunity to witnessup and coming young guns from 4 continents, fighting for their chance to live the Olympic Dream! Dakhla, in Morocco hosts the qualifying event for Europe and Africa, while Pranburi, Thailand is the place where riders from Asia and Oceania will fight for their right to compete in Argentina!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: In this episode we are going to take you into the action from the 2018 milestone event, the International Kiteboarding Association, TT:R Youth Worlds. With 8 qualification spots available for this year’s Youth Olympic Games in Argentina, expect the competition to be fierce!

programme.title: Facing Waves

Even though the surfing scene here is surprisingly small and undeveloped, surfers are passionate as any. This week on Facing Waves we will be paddling Jamaica with Ken Whiting.

programme.title: Facing Waves
programme.desc: 190 miles of paddling route. The Great Calusa Blueway Paddling Trail makes its way through the coastal water and inland tributaries of Lee Country in Florida. Luke Hopkins and Anne Pagano will explore one of the world’s great water trails by stand up paddle board in this week's episode of Facing Waves.

programme.title: China Cup International Regatta
programme.desc: The China Cup International Regatta is the largest international big boat sailing event in Mainland China. Counting with 10 different classes of competition, this international regatta includes 8 challenging races that include a Hong Kong to Shenzhen passage race, inshore races and round the island races.With 1500 sailors from more than 35 different countries and regions expected, the China Cup International Regatta promises to be a complicated competition for sailors that battle for the place on the podium. They will have to sort every challenge presented to them in this extremely well run, fantastic competition.Watch racers compete in their boats across different divisions and categories to raise the Asian title. The China Cup International Regatta 2017 is a competition like no other that demands constant attention, excellent performance and braveness to sail the Chinese seas.

programme.title: Wild Surf
programme.desc: This week on Wild Surf the legendary surfer Garrett McNamara will glide in the water in Portugal, the place he is actually at now. programme.desc: Charlie Head will attempt the first ever stand-up paddle boarding of the main water source of the Amazon, the Rio Marañón in Peru. It’s never been attempted before and will be the most arduous and longest SUP journey ever made.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Journey To Giglio
programme.desc: Journey to Giglio, an investigative piece on the infamous Costa Concordia tragedy, Andi van Zyl on the Italian island of Giglio for an exclusive exposé on the shipwreck that shocked the world. Andi leaves no rock unturned as she digs into what happened the night of the accident and uncovers the disaster’s impact on the local residents and economy.

programme.title: Inside Sailing
programme.desc: Our journey starts this time with the wrapping up of the following 44Cup, a well-established series that is highly regarded in the sailing industry. Among the teams and sailors it attracts, Team Aqua and Peninsula Petroleum are the most loyal ones on the tour.Our next stop takes us to the leading kitefoiler, Florian Gruber who will explain how the COVID-19 virus has affected his daily routine. He would normally spend his time flying around the globe competing in the world's top events, however this is not the current reality. The final stop for this episode includes the top ten moments of GC32 Racing Tour.

programme.title: The World Sailing Show
programme.desc: The World Sailing Show is a close up monthly view of the racing world, a global sailing series featuring the very best action from the world of sailing. We travel the world finding out the most important sailing events, interviewing great personalities in the nautical world and discovering the advances and latest additions to the competitive world. Come jump on board with us as we witness the first capsize of an AC75, build up to the summer Olympic Games, make it to the Sydney-Hobart Yacht Race or discover how Francis Joyon and his IDEC Sprots crew broke new records in sailing. Discover the world of sailing, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight
programme.desc: Out of the fray and sitting pretty after winning the Round Robin qualifiers, Oracle Team USA now waits for the winner. Following the script, France says goodbye while the fabulous four New Zealand, Sweden, Great Britain and Japan take on the Louis Vuitton Challenger Playoffs. We will talk with weather guru inside the role of America's Cup meteorologists and close up at the heart of Artemis Racing, the Swedish Challenger.

programme.title: Les Voiles De St Barth
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

programme.title: Madagascarin Pingviinit
programme.desc: Koska Kowalskin keksinnöt ovat usein vaarallisia, Kippari kieltää häneltä kaiken tieteilyn. Kowalski päättää silti rakentaa näkymättömyyssäteen ja ottaa huomioon kaiken, mikä voi mennä pieleen... paitsi Julienin.

programme.title: Best And Bester
programme.desc: Eka ja Helmi ovat paitsi kaksoset, myös parhaat kaverukset, ja heillä on eräs ainutlaatuinen ominaisuus. Kaupungissa, jossa muut asukkaat pullahtavat maailmaan erilaisissa omalaatuisissa kehoissa, Ekalla ja Helmillä ei ole pysyvää kehoa, vaan he voivat itse tehdä muodonmuutoksen kerran päivässä. Yllätyksellinen, älykäs ja mukaansatempaava kaverikomedia vie valintojen tekemisen teeman uusiin naurettaviin ulottuvuuksiin. Eka ja Helmi osoittavat, että kuka tahansa voi olla mitä vain ja parasta on totta kai olla oma itsensä.

programme.title: Tryggt hemma - Utrymningssäkerhet
programme.desc: I händelse av brand är tiden knapp. I en vanlig bostadsbrand utvecklas situationen till livsfarlig på 2-3 minuter. Av denna orsak bör branden uppfattas snabbt och utrymningen ske utan dröjsmål. Bostadens utrymingsvägar bör vara väl kända samt hinderfria. Detta avsnitt handlar om utrymningssäkerhet.

programme.title: Tervetuloa Kotiin
programme.desc: Turvallista asumista ikääntyville. Sarjassa tapaamme mielenkiintoisia ikäihmisiä, jotka ovat päättäneet asua ja pärjätä kotona mahdollisimman pitkään. Ohjelmassa jaetaan vinkkejä turvalliseen asumiseen. Ohjelma on tekstitetty ruotsiksi.

programme.title: Lätt stolgympa - Helppo tuolijumppa
programme.desc: Tässä jaksossa tehdään helppo tuolijumppa, jossa keskitytään lihasvoimaharjoitteluun fysioterapeutti Linnean kanssa. Jumppa toteutetaan istuen tuoli apuvälineenä. Tuolijumpan tavoite on aktivoida koko vartalon lihakset turvallisella tavalla. Jumppa on ruotsiksi.

programme.desc: TunneMusiikki-tuokio Ruotsi

programme.title: Istumafysio - Tuolijumppaa koko keholle
programme.desc: Lisätään liikkuvuutta ja avataan koko kehoa päivää varten istumafysion avulla. Harjoitus sisältää koko vartalon harjoitteita, jotka keskittyvät liikkuvuuden lisäämiseen sekä lihasten herättelyyn ja venyttämiseen. Jokainen voi osallistua lähtötasosta riippumatta.

programme.title: Tunteet kehossa
programme.desc: Kuten vanha sanonta kuuluu: kuva kertoo enemmän kuin tuhat sanaa. Kokemamme tunteet näkyvät ja tuntuvat kehossa – ne helposti ohjaavat ajatteluamme ja toimintaamme. Tässä jaksossa käydään tunnetiloja läpi liikkeen kautta yhdistellen eri aisteja ja mielikuvia omaan kehoon. Tervetuloa mukaan. Harjoitukset sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Tanssillinen jumppa
programme.desc: Tanssillinen jumppa toteutetaan tänään seisoen, mutta voit tulla mukaan myös istuen. Tule vetreyttämään kehoa musiikin tahtiin ja heittäydy rytmin vietäväksi. Liikkuminen ja koordinaation harjoittaminen tapahtuu huomaamatta, kun on hauskaa.

programme.desc: Settima stagione del programma dedicato alle più belle voci over 60 del paese e alle loro straordinarie storie di vita. Ancora una volta quattro coach, star del panorama musicale, competeranno per aggiudicarsi i loro cantanti preferiti e, una volta formate le squadre, dovranno selezionare i talenti più meritevoli da far accedere alla finale live. Una grande festa della musica, ricca di ospiti e sorprese, in cui il pubblico da casa decreterà il vincitore. Conduce Antonella Clerici.

programme.title: Tg1
programme.desc: Edizione del notiziario televisivo a cura della redazione giornalistica di Rai 1. Ogni giorno, le informazioni più importanti a livello nazionale ed internazionale: cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Tv7
programme.desc: Il caso Garlasco apre la puntata, con i nuovi sviluppi dell'inchiesta sull'omicidio di Chiara Poggi e gli interrogativi emersi a quasi vent'anni dal delitto. Spazio poi alla morte di David Rossi, l'ex responsabile della comunicazione di Monte dei Paschi di Siena, con le nuove perizie e i lavori della Commissione parlamentare d'inchiesta che riaprono il confronto sulle circostanze della sua morte. A tre anni dall'attacco di Hamas del 7 ottobre, un reportage torna nei luoghi del massacro al Nova Festival, tra le testimonianze dei sopravvissuti e le polemiche sulle responsabilità politiche e di sicurezza. Dall'Ucraina, il racconto della guerra attraverso le comunità della regione di Kyiv, ancora colpite dai bombardamenti russi, e le storie dei civili costretti a convivere con la violenza del conflitto. In Sicilia, un viaggio alle pendici dell'Etna racconta le conseguenze dell'attività vulcanica sulla vita quotidiana, sui trasporti e sull'economia del territorio. Spazio anche a un modo diverso di viaggiare, lontano dalle mete più affollate, alla scoperta di luoghi meno conosciuti tra Basilicata, Sicilia e Dolomiti. Infine, dagli archivi di Tv7 del 1963, le testimonianze dei sopravvissuti alla tragedia del Vajont, tra la devastazione provocata dalla frana del monte Toc e la memoria delle comunità colpite.

programme.desc: Federico Quaranta e Daria Luppino raccontano il territorio italiano attraverso un libro che ha come protagonista la città al centro della puntata.

programme.title: Linea Verde Start
programme.desc: In questo nuovo appuntamento di Linea Verde Start, Federico Quaranta torna in Umbria, questa volta per raccontare la profonda eredità culturale che fin dall'epoca etrusca caratterizza la città di Perugia. Il cammino di Federico parte da piazza IV Novembre e ci conduce alla scoperta della città sotterranea, per rivelare l'anima autentica dell'antica Perusia. Dalla storia, il racconto si trasforma in arte, svelando il patrimonio che custodisce l'Abbazia di S. Pietro, fino a raggiungere la provincia umbra, con Deruta, Marsciano e la Rocca Flea di Gualdo Tadino, in un territorio in cui il gesto manuale incontra la tradizione, ma soprattutto la creatività, la tecnologia e l'innovazione, dimostrando che l'artigianato può essere anche contemporaneo, ma soprattutto, rivolto ai giovani e al futuro.

programme.title: Linea Verde Italia
programme.desc: In questa puntata facciamo tappa a Pesaro, una gemma incastonata sulla costa nord delle Marche. Raccontiamo di questa città e del suo territorio, tra mare, monti, musica e maioliche. Una Pesaro che, con la sua Bicipolitana, permette di scoprire splendidi itinerari, insieme a tante altre curiosità tra natura, gastronomia, cultura e arte. Conducono Monica Caradonna e Tinto.

programme.desc: Elisa Isoardi commenta l'attualità in compagnia di Serena Bortone, Rosanna Lambertucci, Gigi Marzullo e Francesco Giubilei. Ogni settimana un piccolo borgo italiano racconta le storie della propria comunità.

programme.title: Passaggio a Nord Ovest
programme.desc: Visitiamo in Valle d'Aosta il Castello di Fénis, uno dei più suggestivi di questa regione, caratterizzato da torri, mura merlate e cicli pittorici in stile gotico tra i più famosi del Nord Italia;- Cristo in Casa di Marta e Maria è un quadro realizzato intorno al 1620 a Siviglia, dal pittore spagnolo Diego Velázquez. Il peperoncino posto sul tavolo sarà la chiave di volta per riscoprire la storia di un'epoca e del mondo intero. Cinduce Alberto Angela. Con la collaborazione di Vito Lamberti ed Emilio Quinto.

programme.title: Henkivartijat (16)
programme.desc: Johan Falkin ystävällä Sven Petterssonilla on vaatefirma, joka toimii osittain ulkomailla. Suojautuakseen Viron mafialta hän turvautuu saksalaiseen turvallisuuseksperttiin. Tämä on kuitenkin gangsteri, ja pian Sven on pulassa.

programme.title: Uutispommi (12)
programme.desc: Christina Furhage, Tukholman tulevista olympialaisista vastaava henkilö, räjäytetään. Alkaa murhaajan takaa-ajo.

programme.title: Från och med Herr Gunnar Papphammar
programme.desc: Komediaklassikossa Gösta Ekman esittää Gunnar Papphammaria, miestä joka jatkuvasti joutuu sotkuisiin tilanteisiin.

programme.title: Vilken jävla cirkus (12)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia kriisissä olevasta nuoresta Hugosta, joka kaatuu pyörällä ja herää sirkuksessa, joka on täynnä värikkäitä tyyppejä.

programme.title: Syyttömänä vankilassa (12)
programme.desc: Conny on kemianopettaja, joka aivan syyttä vedetään huumejuttuun ja tuomitaan vankilaan. Siellä hän oppii tuntemaan ammattirikollisia, jotka hoitavat salaisen tunnelin kautta hämäräbisneksiä. Conny pakotetaan heidän apurikseen.

programme.title: Black Jack (12)
programme.desc: Inger palaa Tukholmasta pienelle kotipaikkakunnalleen epäonnistuneen avioliiton jälkeen. Ensimmäisenä viikonloppuna hän menee tanssimaan tyypilliseen pikkukaupunkilaisbaariin. Siellä hän tapaa muun muassa Kajn, joka rakastuu häneen.

programme.title: The Stig-Helmer story (S)
programme.desc: Seuramatkan, hiihtoloman, purjehduksen, golf- sekä terveysmatkailun jälkeen Stig-Helmer on täällä taas! The Stig-Helmer Story on aikamatka nuoruusvuosiin 1950-luvulle.

programme.title: Så olika (7)
programme.desc: Toisessa elokuvassaan kameran takana Helena Bergström tutkii rakkauden kiemuroita tarinassa kahdesta siskoksesta.

programme.title: Marikki
programme.desc: Marikki ei haluaisi aiheuttaa hankaluuksia, mutta toisinaan asiat eivät mene niin kuin hän oli suunnitellut. Kerrankin hän järjesti retken, joka päättyi pikkusiskon aivotärähdykseen.

programme.title: Ägget är löst! (16)
programme.desc: Rikas johtaja painostaa sekä vaimoaan että poikaansa. Eräänä päivänä poika ottaa ohjat omiin käsiinsä ja yrittää murhata isänsä. Hän kuitenkin epäonnistuu, ja hänet heitetään järveen. Hän päätyy merenpohjaan ja aloittaa siellä uuden elämän.

programme.title: Bröderna Karlsson (12)
programme.desc: Niklasin säännöllinen elämä Tukholmassa muuttuu rajusti, kun hän saa tietää kaksoisveljestään, joka on hänen täysi vastakohtansa.

programme.title: Enkelten talo - toinen kesä (7)
programme.desc: Uusi, mullistava kesä alkaa, kun Fanny ja Zac palaavat Enkelten taloon. Riidat ja kaksinaismoraali ovat tallella yhtä terävinä kuin ennenkin. Paljastuu että Gottfridillä ja Ivarilla on veli Sven, joka muutti Amerikkaan lapsena. Heidän etsimisestään ei ole koskaan ollut puhetta. Hänhän asuu Amerikassa - ja Gottfrid ja Ivar eivät ole käyneet edes Göteborgissa. He eivät kuitenkaan mahda Fannyn suostuttelulle mitään ja löytävät itsensä New Yorkista.

programme.title: Lain nimessä (16)
programme.desc: Neljän poliisin ryhmä kiertelee Tukholman kaduilla hakkaamassa juoppoja ja rikollisia. Kun ryhmän pidättämä alkoholisti löytyy putkasta kuolleena, rikostarkastaja Jarnebring alkaa tutkia heidän toimiaan tarkemmin. Samalla tutkittavaksi joutuu kaupungin ravintolakuningas Danucci, jota epäillään laajasta huumekaupasta.

programme.title: Peitenimi Coq Rouge (16)
programme.desc: Ensimmäinen elokuva huippukoulutetusta tiedustelupalvelun salaisesta agentista, joka saa tehtäväkseen tutkia Ruotsissa suunniteltua operaatiota.

programme.title: Kolmas aalto (16)
programme.desc: Lopetettuaan poliisintyönsä Johan Falk aloittaa uudessa työryhmässä Europolissa, jonka tarkoitus on taistella suuria talousrikollisia vastaan. Näyttää siltä, että alkamassa on pitkä rivi painajaismaisia tapahtumia, väkivaltaa ja petosta.

programme.title: Sopor
programme.desc: Tukholman linnan vallataan, ja kuningaspari otetaan panttivangiksi. Valtaajina toimii joukko lapsia, jotka eivät halua kenenkään tuntevan oloaan tarpeettomaksi. Lasten joukossa on itse prinsessa Victoria.

programme.title: Angel (12)
programme.desc: 80-luvulla Angelica Holst oli juhlittu rocktähti, mutta moneen vuoteen hänen levynsä eivät ole soineet hittilistoila. Hän yrittää epätoivoisesti päästä takaisin lehtien kansiin ja lavastaa oman kuolemansa. Seuraukset ovat arvaamattomat.

programme.title: Ronja Ryövärintytär (7)
programme.desc: Ronjan elämä alkoi dramaattisesti. Kun hän syntyi, kalliolla ja metsissä salamoi, ja ryövärikuningas Mattis oli onnellinen, sillä se merkitsi sitä, että heimoon saatiin uusi ryövärijohtaja. Samana yönä Ronjalle kuitenkin syntyi kilpailija...

programme.title: Joker (1991)
programme.desc: Nicke rakastaa käytännönpiloja, joten Pellen mennessä naimisiin Nicke on vastuussa polttareista, jotka alkavat kidnappauksella. Kaikki menee tosin pieleen ja terroristit kidnappaavat Pellen oikeasti.

programme.title: Ninas resa (12)
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva draama teini-ikäisen Ninan ja tämän perheen elämästä Varsovan getossa toisen maailmansodan aikana. Nina rakastuu, juhlii, opiskelee ja valmistuu ylioppilaaksi. Samalla ihmiset hänen ympärillään katoavat yksi toisensa jälkeen. Elokuva perustuu ohjaaja Lena Einhornin kirjaan äitinsä nuoruusvuosista, ja se sai kaksi Guldbagge-palkintoa (paras elokuva, paras käsikirjoitus).

programme.title: Peter And Petra
programme.desc: Ekaluokkalainen Gunnar on jo kyllästynyt kouluun. Sitten hän tutustuu Peteriin ja Petraan. Heistä tulee Gunnarin parhaat ystävät. Koulunkäynti alkaa taas maittaa.

programme.title: Bonusperhe-elokuva (7)
programme.desc: Lisan ja Patrikin liitto on taas paremmalla tolalla Patrikin uskottomuuden jäljiltä, mutta sitten käräjäoikeudesta saapuu yllättävä kirje. Lisa on unohtanut vireille panemansa avioerohakemuksen, ja nyt ero on astunut voimaan. Järkyttynyt Patrik päättää yllättää Lisan hääjuhlallisuuksilla. Pian selviää, että Lisakin on ollut uskoton, ja asetelma keikahtaa päälaelleen. Elokuva on jatkoa suositulle Bonusperhe-tv-sarjalle. Ohjaaja: Felix Herngren. Rooleissa: Vera Vitali, Erik Johansson, Fredrik Hallgren, Klara Hodell, Christer Lindarw, Marianne Mörck, Johan Ulveson.

programme.title: Seuramatka (S)
programme.desc: Kanarian saarilla on joulun aikaan sikajuhlat, ja siellä Stig Helmer Olsson on ensimmäisellä ulkomaanmatkallaan. Hän ei tiedä että tohtori Levander, joka on hoitanut hänen lentopelkoaan, on huijannut häntä tuomaan saarille pimeästi rahaa.

programme.title: Göta Kanal 2 (12)
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sitten kaksi laivaa purjehti kilpaa Götan kanavan läpi. Tapaus nousi kuuluisuuteen. Nyt on uuden kilpailun aika, ja tällä kertaa laivoja seuraa tuotantoyhtiö, joka on tehnyt kilpailusta livenä lähetetyn saippuadokumentin.

programme.title: Peppi seitsemällä merellä (S)
programme.desc: Eräänä päivänä Peppi saa pullopostia. Hänen isänsä, kapteeni Pitkätossu, on joutunut merirosvojen haaviin, ja nyt hän pyytää vahvaa tytärtään avuksi. Peppi ei epäröi hetkeäkään vaan kääntää kokkansa kohti Etelämerta.

programme.title: Änglagård - Tredje gången gillt (7)
programme.desc: Fanny (Helena Bergström) palaa kotikyläänsä viimeisen kerran selvittääkseen, kuka oikeastaan on hänen isänsä.

programme.title: Arn - Temppeliritari (12)
programme.desc: Jan Guilloun menestyskirjat Arn Magnussonista ovat taustana kalleimmalle Ruotsissa koskaan tehdylle filmisijoitukselle.

programme.title: Demokraattinen terroristi (16)
programme.desc: Saksan tiedustelupalvelu on saanut vihiä saksalaisista terroristeista Ruotsissa. Nyt etsitään henkilöä, joka soluttautuisi Punaisen Armeijakunnan viimeiseen ryhmään. Vasemmistotaustainen Carl Hamilton on ainoa mahdollinen ehdokas.

programme.title: Metsästäjät 1 (16)
programme.desc: Ampumakohtauksen jälkeen poliisi muuttaa takaisin Norlantiin yhteiskuntaan, jota hallitsevat kirjoittamattomat lait.

programme.title: Kapinalliset (16)
programme.desc: Jack on 25-vuotias. Kavereineen hän polttaa, juopottelee ja iskee tyttöjä Tukholmassa. Toisin kun moni muu, Jack tietää mitä hänestä tulee isona: kirjailija. Hänen jengissään pyörii Bart, joka haluaa taiteilijaksi sekä Harald, joka myy huumeita. He seurustelevat valokuvaaja-Jonnyn ja tämän tyttöystävän Linnean kanssa. Yhdessä he kokevat iloa ja surua, pohtivat elämää ja matkustavat Gotlantiin polkupyöräilemään.

programme.title: Kissanviiksiä ja herneitä (S)
programme.desc: Kömpelön jokapaikanhöylän Claes-Henrikin on huijattava äitinsä ulos asunnosta pariksi päiväksi. Rahaa on luvassa, mutta tehtävä ei ole helppo.

programme.title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
programme.desc: Dee on mustasukkainen Tarjoilijan naimisiinmenosta ennen itseään ja tekee kaikkensa kaataakseen häät. Muut harhauttavat Charlieta saamalla hänet taas deittailemaan.

programme.title: Criminal Minds: Evolution
programme.desc: Tiimi tutkii verkoston tappajaa, joka hautaa uhrinsa elävältä.

programme.title: High Potential
programme.desc: Halloween on ovella, ja tiimi tutkii karmivaa tapausta. Rikas lakimies löytyy kuolleena viktoriaanisesta kummituskartanostaan. Ylikomisario Wagner yllättää kaikki taidoillaan, ja kotona Eliott toimii sovittelijana Morganin ja Avan välillä.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Alkuperäisen Star Trekin näyttelijät pilailevat tässä jaksossa sarjansa ja sen vannoutuneiden fanien kustannuksella. Kuultuaan, että sarja kiellettiin Maassa 2200-luvulla (maailman johtajien mielestä Star Trek -liike oli liian uhkaava) Fry päättää lähteä hakemaan nauhoitetut jaksot, jotka lähetettiin kielletylle planeetalle. Ryhmä matkaa Omega 3:lle, jossa Fry päätyy tietokilpailuun olennon kanssa, joka väittää olevansa kaikista suurin Trek-fani.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Kun ilmaston lämpeneminen uhkaa maapalloa, ryhmä osallistuu Kiotossa konferenssiin, jota isännöi Al Goren pää.

programme.title: Melkein MENSA
programme.desc: Melkein MENSA –viihdekisailussa tietämättömyys lisää tuskaa. Tämä erilainen viihdeohjelma on täynnä naurua ja kiperiä tilanteita. Ohjelmaa juontaa mediapersoona Juha Perälä, ja toisen joukkueen vakiokapteenina ruoria vääntelee näyttelijä Eero Ritala. Kussakin jaksossa käsittelyyn otetaan kaksi teemaa, joilla ei ole mitään yhteistä nimittäjää. Tässä ohjelmassa tyhmyydestä rankaistaan ja vastaamaan pääsee vasta suoritettuaan eriskummallisia tehtäviä. Melkein mensan haasteisiin tarttuvat tämän hetken kiinnostavimmat vieraat. Joka viikko mukana on kolme uutta vierasta: kaksi heistä muodostaa yhden kilpailujoukkueen, ja kolmas vieras kilpailee Eero Ritalan parina. Viides tuotantokausi.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Tohtori Zoidberg tuomitaan kuolemaan Maan lipun syömisestä.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Tohtori Zoidberg tuomitaan kuolemaan Maan lipun syömisestä.

programme.title: Master Cleaners Suomi
programme.desc: Kilpailijat saavat allensa ostoskeskuksista tutun yleiskoneen ja äärimmäinen rallikisa on valmis alkamaan. Kuka osaa tehdä parhaat ostokset etutehtävässä ja kenen putket ovat puhtaimmat lopussa? Vieraana selostajalegenda Matti Kyllönen, tuomarina Auri Kananen ja juontajana Ellen Jokikunnas.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Silent Library Suomi -kirjastossa yritetään olla siivosti kun siivoojaguru Auri Kananen saapuu kavereineen paikalle. Mukana Viivi Kuusela, Saara Piispanen, Khaled Azizi, Jordan Haardcore sekä Santtu Koskiaho. Kirjastossa kuria pitää Suomen tiukin juontaja Riku Rantala, joka ei anna armoa. Nyt siististi siellä!

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work’s instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Zubin Mehta And Israel Philharmonic Orchestra - In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. Renowned as one of the world’s foremost interpreters of the great symphonic repertoire—especially the Romantic works of Anton Bruckner, Gustav Mahler, and Richard Strauss—Mehta had conducted this popular masterpiece many times before. However, this was the first occasion he rehearsed it from the very beginning with the orchestra. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle And London Symphony Orchestra - Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland, Thomas Oliemans And Marina Prudenskaja - Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein. Thus, he conveys an intense musical experience to the listener with his intuitive musical style, his exquisite melodic lines and accessible harmonic language. All this makes him to be a hugely popular composer with American orchestras.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg And Jimmy J¢rgensen - Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime. It was arranged for many various instrumental ensembles, including versions for two guitars, and piano four-hands, but also a trio for clarinet (or violin), cello, and piano, arranged by Beethoven himself. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in 2020.

programme.title: Peter-Paul Kainrath - The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Paolo Belloli, Francesco Attesti And Italian OIDA Orchestra - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón And Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images. It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Esa-Pekka Salonen And Los Angeles Philharmonic - In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano - Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The main section of the ballade is built from two main themes which return in different keys after which a thundering chord introduces the Presto con fuoco, which eventually ends the piece in a fiery double octave scale run down the keyboard. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak.

programme.title: Olivier Latry, Emmanuel Curt, Shin-Young Lee And Damien Petitjean - Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris. Besides enriching the musical world as an organist, improvisor and composer, Olivier Latry also works as a Professor of Organ at the Conservatoire de Paris. This performance of his, showcasing pieces of Bach, Vierne and Daquin, was recorded in 2015, at Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst And Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's Resurrection Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale. The symphony features immense orchestral forces, including offstage brass and a large choir, which combine to create overwhelming sonic experiences that depict profound spiritual and emotional narratives. The grand scale and dramatic structure represent the triumph of life over death.

programme.title: Philippe Herreweghe, Collegium Vocale Gent, Dorothee Mields And Thomas Hobbs - J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij. The program continues with a fine selection of Bach’s works performed by French lutenist Thomas Dunford. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. This concert was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programme.title: Enrico Pace - Bach - Sonata No. 5 BWV 1018
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 5 BWV 1014 is the fifth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians. The different pieces are meant to be a set, just like the Brandenburg concertos. Performers: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano)

programme.title: Hannu Lintu - Sibelius – Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy. His many concerts with the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra in 2012 made him the obvious replacement for Sakari Oramo, who, after many years as conductor and concert master, terminated his contract in 2012. The orchestra specializes in the performance of Finnish music, but also performs the great masterpieces of Gustav Mahler and Béla Bartók. The Finnish composer Jean Sibelius is the orchestra’s favourite, as well as the conductor. In cooperation with Finland’s national public broadcasting company Yle, all seven Sibelius symphonies are recorded and broadcast. After a brief spoken introduction about the piece, the orchestra performs the complete symphony. While composing his Symphony No. 5, Sibelius was also sketching his Symphony No. 6, using a number of ideas he could not fit in his No. 5 for No. 6. The music is based on modal lines, which are often used in church music. His Symphony No. 6 has few melodic lines and a slightly gloomier atmosphere. For that reason, Sibelius added the description ‘When shadows lengthen’ to the title.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland And Hartmut Haenchen - Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The German-born conductor, who became a Dutch citizen through naturalisation, was chief conductor at the Dutch National Opera, the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra, and the Netherlands Chamber Orchestra before he was finally knighted for his services to the Dutch music landscape. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner. Bruckner's use of Wagner tubas and double bass tubas creates an even more solemn and grandiose air within the Adagio. Trumpet signals refer to crowing cockerels as they interrupt the grim and clamorous Scherzo. In the Finale, Bruckner employs a persistent rhythmic pulse that starts softly yet builds up towards the explosive final bars.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel And Isabel Schwartzbach - Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström And Christine Nonbo Andersen - Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra And Andres Gabetta - The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know The Four Seasons of Vivaldi, it is one of the hits of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Misha Mengelberg - Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt And Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as “an infinity of contrast”, “a setting of the small world beside the great”, and where “a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness”. Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sophia Burgos And Daniel Gerzenberg - IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!’, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Enrico Bronzi, Orchestra da Camera di Perugia, Linda Di Carlo And Marco Scolastra - Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia.

programme.title: Naoya Nishimura - Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: This BBC film Barenboim on Beethoven: Nine Symphonies that Changed the World follows the renowned West-Eastern Divan Orchestra on their ground-breaking tour of South Korea and China. The film gives a unique insight into the nine symphonies, as well as the musicians’ viewson the difficulties and delights of performing these inimitable works

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. His Fantasie in C, Op. 17, was written in 1836. It was revised prior to publication in 1839 and dedicated to Franz Liszt. It is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano and a central work of the early Romantic period.

programme.title: Myung-whun Chung And Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino - Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese in den Jahren 1908 und 1909 geschriebene Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete. Der abergläubische Mahler wollte ursprünglich keine neunte Sinfonie schreiben, weil er an den sogenannten „Fluch der Neunten“ glaubte. Schließlich starben auch die Komponisten Ludwig van Beethoven und Anton Bruckner, bevor sie ihre zehnte Sinfonie vollenden konnten. Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 9 wurde am 26. Juni 1912 in Wien uraufgeführt, gespielt von den Wiener Philharmonikern unter der Leitung von Bruno Walter. Leider erlebte der Komponist dies nicht mehr: Er verstarb im Jahr zuvor. Diese Aufführung wurde 2021 im Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florenz, Italien, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Mark Perna - Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam And Conrad van Alphen - Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed Farewell because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas. In early November 1772, the prince announced his intention to remain at the palace for two more months. The musicians then told Kapellmeister Haydn their disagreement with this forced extension of their stay. The solution proposed by Haydn was to compose a piece delivering a clear message: at the end of the last movement of the Symphony, the musicians were called to blow the candles on their lectern and leave the room one after the other. Prince Nicholas understood the message; the next day a car was waiting for the musicians to take them home.

programme.title: Aquarius - Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter. This deals with the human and the divine, weakness and strength, suffering and redemption, mortality and immortality. In this broadcast, ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ is performed by the chamber choir Aquarius. This Flemish chamber choir is a trailblazer where new music and new concert formats are concerned. ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ is a great example of this: the singers are positioned in a circle in the center of a church. This dark church is only lit by candles and the music stand lights. After the choir has entered in procession, they sing for close to two hours. Performed by the Aquarius Choir led by Michael de Smet in 2008.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam, Conrad van Alphen, Octopus Symphonic Choir And Gulnara Shafigullina - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 is widely considered Beethoven’s greatest composition. He completed this symphony in 1824, when he was almost completely deaf. This symphony is unique, since Beethoven included a choir and vocal soloists in the last movement, in which he set parts of Friedrich Schiller's poem “Ode an die Freude” (“Ode to Joy”) to music. The symphony consists of four movements: Allegro ma non troppo, un poco maestoso, Molto vivace, Adagio molto e cantabile, and Finale. The four vocal soloists are Gulnara Shafigullina (soprano), Claire Barnett-Jones (mezzosoprano), Matthew Newlin (tenor), and Frederik Bergman (baritone).

programme.title: Stefano Conticello, Orchestra del Teatro Comunale di Bologna And Maurizio Baglini - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello, Orchestra del Teatro Comunale di Bologna And Maurizio Baglini - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35

programme.title: Inna Faliks - Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra And Michael Tilson Thomas - Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: David Levy - Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S. Bach’s famous The Well-Tempered Clavier (BWV 846-893), a collection of forty-eight preludes and fugues published in two books. A panel member at Leipzig’s Bach competition, Shostakovich was deeply inspired by Russian pianist Tatiana Nikolayeva’s performance of Bach’s 48 Preludes and Fugues. Shostakovich wrote these pieces between the autumn of 1950 and February 1951, dedicating them to Nikolayeva, who agreed to perform the Leningrad premiere in December 1952. David Levy’s performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. Remarkably, the harpsichord appears as a solo instrument here, along with the flute and violin, rather than as an accompanying instrument. The piece is therefore considered one of Bach’s very first keyboard concertos.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja And Ensemble Musica Aeterna - Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn And Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Ballets de Monte Carlo - Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: The original version of the ballet Romeo and Juliet by Sergei Prokofiev is based on Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet. Music from the ballet was extracted by Prokofiev as three suites for orchestra and as a piano work. In this film Romeo and Juliet, also inspired by Shakespeare, tensions run high in the choir, and the visual imagery is fluid and strong, just like the music. Thierry Malandain’s choreography features arabesques, pirouettes, and jumps constantly broken and redistributed in an urgent motion. The music of this performance is composed by Hector Berlioz. Performers are part of the Les Ballets de Monte-Carlo and the performance took place at the Victoria Eugenia Theater in Spain.

programme.title: Riccardo Frizza, Orchestra Gli Originali, Coro Donizetti Opera And Caterina Sala - Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina. After hearing about the legend of Tristan and Isolde, the desperate Nemorino wonders if a love potion would help him to gain Adina’s love. He seeks help of the travelling quack Dr. Dulcamara, from whom he purchases a bottle of magic elixir. Directed by Frederic Wake-Walker, this 2021 production is unique as it features the complete, original score as reconstructed by Alberto Zedda based on Donizetti’s autographs. In addition, the orchestra plays on historical instruments to recreate the sound of Donizetti’s orchestra. Among the soloists are Caterina Sala (Adina), Javier Camarena (Nemorino), Florian Sempey (Belcore), Roberto Frontali (Dulcamara), Anaïs Mejías (Giannetta), and Manuel Ferreira (Master of ceremonies). This performance was part of the Donizetti Opera Festival, recorded at Teatro Donizetti in Bergamo, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Conrad van Alphen, Sinfonia Rotterdam, Vlaams Radio Koor And Melle de Vries - Veerhavenconcert 2016
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. As part of this annual event presented in the port of Rotterdam, the musicians perform on a floating stage, and audiences watch the show on the dock and on boats. This fantastic concert features soloists Maria Warenberg (mezzo-soprano) and Melle de Vries (cello), who perform works by Mendelssohn, Mozart, Haydn, Rossini, Beethoven, and Fauré.

programme.title: Philippe Cassard - In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Paolo Belloli, Francesco Attesti And Italian OIDA Orchestra - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle, London Symphony Orchestra, Magdalena Kožená And Andrew Staples - Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Betrachten Sie die kurze, grenzenlose Freude des Lebens und das drohende Gespenst des Todes in Mahlers äußerst bewegendem Liederzyklus „Das Lied von der Erde“ – ein Werk, das in Größe und Umfang ebenso episch ist wie seine monumentalen Symphonien. Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um unsere erste Aufführung im Barbican seit über einem Jahr zu geben, und nehmen Sie mit auf Mahlers zutiefst persönliche Reise. Geschrieben in den letzten Jahren seines Lebens und nach dem tragischen Tod seiner Tochter ringt Mahler mit der Vergänglichkeit des Lebens; er kontrastiert Momente von Lebendigkeit und Glück mit tiefer Introspektion und Melancholie in einigen seiner schönsten symphonischen Kompositionen. Aufgenommen am 9. Mai 2021.

programme.title: The Expendables 3 (12)
programme.desc: The Expendables -ryhmän perustanut Barney käy taistoon vanhaa tiimiläistä vastaan uuden, nuoremman, vahvemman ja teknisesti taitavamman ryhmänsä kanssa. Edessä on The Expendables -porukan henkilökohtaisin taistelu.

programme.title: The Mummy (15)
programme.desc: Muinaisen prinsessan (Sofia Boutella) kohtalo riistettiin aikoinaan epäoikeudenmukaisesti. Hänet haudattiin aavikon alle, mutta hän herää henkiin nykyaikana. Prinsessan kostonhimo on kasvanut tuhansien vuosien ajan, ja sen kauhut saavat inhimillisen käsityskyvyn rajoja koettelevat mittasuhteet.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity (12)
programme.desc: Jason löydetään merestä keho täynnä luodinreikiä. Vähitellen hän tajuaa olevansa erittäin vaarallinen mies vailla muistikuvaa väkivaltaisesta menneisyydestään. Pelastaakseen henkensä Jasonin on ratkaistava oman henkilöllisyytensä arvoitus.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door (7)
programme.desc: Komedia entisestä CIA-vakoojasta Bob Hosta, joka kohtaa kovan paikan joutuessaan vahtimaan tyttöystävänsä lapsia. Kaiken kukkuraksi miehen riesana on venäläinen terroristi.

programme.title: Mortdecai (12)
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelun kanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta. Sanotaan, että se sisältää salaisen koodin, jonka avulla voi löytää huikean summan kätkössä olevia natsimiljoonia, ja Charlie vainuaa mahdollisuuden saada itselleen palasen tästä kakusta.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III (7)
programme.desc: Paleontologi Alan Grant saa tarjouksen ryhtyä oppaaksi rikkaalle pariskunnalle Isla Sorna -dinosaurussaaren ylilennolle. Vastoin Grantin tahtoa retkikunta laskeutuu dinosaurusten asuttamalle saarelle.

programme.title: Chaos Walking (12)
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuuden maailmassa Todd Hewitt (Tom Holland) löytää metsästä mysteerisen lentoaluksellaan pakkolaskun tehneen tytön Violan (Daisy Ridley). Viola huomaa yllätyksekseen laskeutuneensa planeetalle, josta kaikki naiset ovat kadonneet. Jäljelle jääneet miehet ovat puolestaan altistuneet voimalle nimeltä Ääni, joka saattaa miesten pienimmätkin ajatukset ääneen kaikkien kuultaville. Viola huomaa pian, että miesten hallitsemassa maailmassa hänen henkensä naisena on vaarassa. Todd päättää auttaa Violaa pakenemaan. Kaksikon pakomatka käynnistää tapahtumaketjun, joka paljastaa uuden yhteiskunnan synkimmät salaisuudet.

programme.title: Sahara (12)
programme.desc: Seikkailija Dirk Pitt lähtee Länsi-Afrikan aavikolle etsimään sisällissodan aikana kadonnutta taistelulaivaa ja auttaa samalla avustusjärjestön lääkäriä jäljittämään tappavaa virusta.

programme.title: Jurassic World (12)
programme.desc: Tänä päivänä Jurassic World ottaa vastaan kymmeniä tuhansia kävijöitä, mutta puiston nähtävyyksien takana piilee uhka: geneettisesti muunneltu dinosaurus, jolla on julmia kykyjä.

programme.title: Transporter 2 (15)
programme.desc: Entinen erikoisjoukkojen mies Frank Martin on varakaan perheen autonkuljettajana, mutta kun perheen poika kidnapataan, Frank lähtee sieppaajien jäljille. Toimintatrilleri.

programme.title: Peppermint (15)
programme.desc: Viisi vuotta aiemmin Riley Northin mies ja tytär kuolivat järjettömässä väkivaltarikoksessa. Riley on päättänyt, että on aika kostaa sekä syyllisille että oikeusjärjestelmälle.

programme.title: Jason Bourne (12)
programme.desc: Matt Damon palaa agentti Jason Bournen rooliin Medusa-trillerisarjan viidennessä osassa. Hiljaiseloa viettänyt ex-agentti astuu nyt esiin varjoista ja muistaa vihdoin lähes kaiken mitä tapahtui. Häntä vaivaava kysymys ei olekaan enää mitä, vaan miksi. 120 min. Ohjaus: Paul Greengrass. Pääosissa: Matt Damon, Julia Stiles, Vincent Cassel, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander. (toiminta, USA, 2016)

programme.title: The Expendables 4 (15)
programme.desc: Palkkasotilaiden parhaimmistoa edustavat Jason Statham, Dolph Lundgren, Randy Couture ja Sylvester Stallone yhdistävät voimansa ensimmäistä kertaa Curtis ”50 Cent” Jacksonin, Megan Foxin, Tony Jaan, Iko Iwaisin, Jacob Scipion, Levy Tranin ja Andy Garcian kanssa. The Expendables on aseistettu kaikin mahdollisin keinoin ja taistelutaidoin, kun tämä maailman viimeinen puolustuslinja kutsutaan tulitaistoon. Ryhmän tulokkaat antavat tuoreella ammattitaidollaan ”uudelle verelle” kuitenkin täysin uuden merkityksen.

programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods (15)
programme.desc: Viisi nuorta lähtee lomalle syrjäiseen metsämökkiin. Takkatulen ääressä kerrotaan kummitusjuttuja. Luulet tietäväsi tarinan, mutta tällä kertaa matto vedetäänkin jalkojesi alta - rytisten!

programme.title: Collide (12)
programme.desc: Adrenaliinintäyteisessä toimintaelokuvassa Saksassa majaileva amerikkalaismies tekee uhkarohkean ryöstön saadakseen rahat tyttöystävänsä leikkaukseen.

programme.title: Chaos Walking (12)
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuuden maailmassa Todd Hewitt (Tom Holland) löytää metsästä mysteerisen lentoaluksellaan pakkolaskun tehneen tytön Violan (Daisy Ridley). Viola huomaa yllätyksekseen laskeutuneensa planeetalle, josta kaikki naiset ovat kadonneet. Kaksikon pakomatka käynnistää tapahtumaketjun, joka paljastaa uuden yhteiskunnan synkimmät salaisuudet.

programme.title: Jurassic World (12)
programme.desc: Tänä päivänä Jurassic World ottaa vastaan kymmeniä tuhansia kävijöitä, mutta puiston nähtävyyksien takana piilee uhka: geneettisesti muunneltu dinosaurus, jolla on julmia kykyjä.

programme.title: Pixels (12)
programme.desc: Ryhmä entisiä kasarivideopelimestareita on ihmiskunnan ainoa toivo torjua avaruusolioiden hyökkäys tässä visuaalisesti näyttävässä toimintaseikkailussa.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt (12)
programme.desc: Tässä muinaisen Egyptin mytologiasta ammentavassa toimintaseikkailussa koko ihmiskunnan tulevaisuus on vaakalaudalla, kun tavallinen kuolevainen Bek nousee sankariksi ryhtyessään pelastamaan maailmaa ja tosirakkauttaan. Onnistuakseen tehtävässään hän värvää avukseen voimakkaan jumalan, Horuksen, taisteluun Sethiä, armotonta pimeyden jumalaa, vastaan.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Kaatunut valtakunta (12)
programme.desc: Kun dinosaurussaari Isla Nublarin tulivuori herää eloon, Owenin ja Clairen täytyy pelastaa viimeiset elossa olevat dinosaurukset – ennen kuin ne tuhoutuvat kokonaan.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (12)
programme.desc: Neljän nuoren löytämä vanha konsoli sisältää ikivanhan pelin – Jumanji. Heidän täytyy selvittää, mitä Alan Parrish jätti taakseen 20 vuotta sitten – muuten he jäävät jumiin pelin sisälle.

programme.title: Non-Stop (12)
programme.desc: New Yorkista Lontooseen matkaava lentopoliisi Bill Marks saa älypuhelimeensa epäilyttävän tekstiviestin. Joku uhkaa tappaa yhden matkustajan joka 20. minuutti, ellei 150 miljoonaa dollaria siirretä uhkaajan ilmoittamalle tilille. Kolmen käsikirjoittajan voimin kehitelty juonikuvio on ilahduttavan energinen, intensiivinen ja loppuun saakka yllättävä. Laatikon ulkopuolelle pyrkivä kamera-ajattelu ja sen ruokkimat liike- ja rajausvalinnat laajentavat matkustamoon survotun painekattilanäytelmän puitteita nautittavasti.

programme.title: Resident Evil (15)
programme.desc: Raccoon Cityn alapuolella sijaitsevassa salaisessa tutkimuskeskuksessa, Pesässä, joku rikkoo säiliön, joka sisältää vaarallista regeneroivaa T-virusta.

programme.desc: Ryhmä entisiä kasarivideopelimestareita on ihmiskunnan ainoa toivo torjua avaruusolioiden hyökkäys tässä visuaalisesti näyttävässä toimintaseikkailussa.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby (15)
programme.desc: Rakastettu Bridget Jones -sinkkusaaga jatkuu tuttujen tähtien kera. Maailman suosituimman sinkun elämässä kääntyy uusi sivu, kun Bridget huomaa yllätyksekseen olevansa raskaana. 123 min. Ohjaus: Sharon Maguire. Pääosissa: Reneé Zellweger, Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey, Emma Thompson, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones, Celia Imrie, Shirley Henderson, James Callis, Sarah Solemani, Sally Phillips.

programme.title: A Dog’s Purpose (7)
programme.desc: Koira syntyy aina uudelleen eri rotuisena. Jokaisessa elämässään koira saa kodin eri ihmisten luona, ja omaan koiraansa ihastuvien ihmisten elämä kääntyy paremmaksi. Uskollinen nelijalkainen ystävä luo jokaiselle toivoa ja onnea.

programme.title: Itse Ilkimys 3 (0)
